subject.title: Control UI chat history hardcoded to 100 messages, no load more pagination

question: Should this issue be resolved by a larger fixed initial Control UI history window, or should closure require a bounded load-older pagination UI using the current chat.history offset contract?
rationale: Current source proves the fixed 100-message UI window, but choosing fixed-batch mitigation versus pagination changes UX, payload cost, and how this issue relates to the canonical scrollback PR path.

options.title: Require bounded load-older pagination
options.body: Keep this issue open until Control UI can fetch older pages on demand with offset/hasMore and tests or browser proof show messages older than the first 100 are reachable.

options.title: Accept fixed-batch mitigation
options.body: Close only after maintainers intentionally accept a larger fixed window as sufficient and the linked mitigation lands with render behavior and proof aligned.

options.title: Route entirely through the canonical issue
options.body: Treat the remaining behavior as owned by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92317 and close this issue only after the same-author linked PR is resolved or explicitly detached.

recommendation.title: Require bounded load-older pagination
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until Control UI can fetch older pages on demand with offset/hasMore and tests or browser proof show messages older than the first 100 are reachable.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent PR metadata put the active Control UI/WebChat history path under vincentkoc's recent work, making them the best available routing owner for the product-shape decision.
